# Miami DJ Beat LLC

> Professional DJs and event production company based in Miami, FL (Entertainment & Events Corporation). Bilingual (Spanish/English) DJ, MC, sound, lighting, and specialty entertainment for weddings, quinceañeras, corporate events, nightlife, and private parties across Miami-Dade, Broward, and the Florida Keys.

Contact: miamidjbeat@gmail.com · +1 (305) 607-1780 · https://www.miamidjbeat.com/contact.html

## Core services

- [Wedding DJ Miami](https://www.miamidjbeat.com/weddings.html): Bilingual DJ & MC, sound and lighting for weddings.
- [Quinceañera DJ Miami](https://www.miamidjbeat.com/quinceanera.html): Bilingual DJ & MC, vals and surprise choreography for quinceañeras.
- [Corporate Event DJ Miami](https://www.miamidjbeat.com/corporate.html): Brand activations, galas, and audio/visual production for corporate events.
- [Hora Loca Show Miami](https://www.miamidjbeat.com/hora-loca.html): LED robots, samba dancers, and character performers.
- [Latin DJ Miami](https://www.miamidjbeat.com/latin-dj.html): Latin music DJ for clubs and private parties.
- [Club & Resident DJ Miami](https://www.miamidjbeat.com/club-dj.html): Nightlife, residencies, and themed nights.
- [DJ Animador & MC Miami](https://www.miamidjbeat.com/mc-dj.html): Bilingual hosting and live hype for events.
- [DJ in Florida Keys](https://www.miamidjbeat.com/florida-keys.html): DJ and event production for Key Largo, Islamorada, and Key West.
- [Full services & rentals hub](https://www.miamidjbeat.com/rentals.html): Lighting, staging, tents, LED screens, furniture, and equipment rentals.
